raw_response:
My plot is small, only 0.12 hectare, and I grow sorghum with another crop mixed in. I have some schooling so I know fertilizer helps, but here in Benshagul Gumuz the cooperative supply is often late and I must be careful with my money. I will put a little DAP at planting if I can get it, and use manure from my animals to stretch it. I keep my own sorghum seed from last harvest — the local variety does well here and the improved seed is hard to find and expensive. Most of the work I do myself with my family; maybe I call a neighbor for a day or two at weeding time.
